description: The pfB-DNS switch dns/pfb_dns (issue #4038, sub-slice 9g): DNSBL is active only while pfBlockerNG, pfB-DNS and DNSBL are on (pfb_dnsbl_active()). A case's stored value is what config.xml holds (absent when the case has none); php is today's reader, PfbConfig::read('dns/pfb_dns') === PfbToggle::On, as pfb_dnsbl_active() compares it; pfbDnsEnabled is what the settings adapter answers in dns, read-only. A refused row is a value Core refuses to read.

cases.description: Nothing stored: the registry default '' reads Off, so DNSBL is not active.
The DNS page's switch off stores '': Off.
The DNS page's switch on stores 'on': On.
A hand-edited 'On': the toggle reader takes any case.
Hostile: 'yes' is no On spelling: Off.
Hostile: ' on' with a leading space is not trimmed: Off.
Hostile: an array where a scalar is stored: Off, without a warning.

refused.description: The stored spelling, not a boolean.
